title: 第11章  诞生麒麟儿真龙，恐怖的奖励
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
content_zh:
刹那间。
异变突起。
原本薄弱的院门，突然变得漆黑如墨。
恐怖吸力骤然爆发。
“什么东西？”
刀疤脸惊呼一声，想抽刀后退，却发现陷入了泥沼。
根本动弹不得。
紧接着。
地面炸裂。
数十张早已埋藏好的二阶爆炎符，如同火药桶，瞬间被引爆。
剧烈的火光吞噬了院门口。
并没有太大的声响。
因为李长生在最外层还套了一层隔音结界。
所有的爆炸威力都被压缩在方圆三丈之内，威力反而倍增。
“啊。”
“我的腿。”
“这是什么符箓？怎么威力这么大？”
两位魔修瞬间被炸懵了。
护体灵罩在经过改良的三阶极品爆炎符面前，脆弱得像张纸。
几乎瞬间便碎裂了。

两位魔修直接被炸懵了。
头脑晕晕的。
尚未回过神来。
李长生便用神识操控着玄霜剑，激射出数道剑气。
玄霜剑是玄阶灵器。
本就威力巨大。
而且攻其不备。
那两位魔修根本来不及躲避。
剑气便精准地刺入两人的眉心、咽喉、心脏。
生机断绝。
轰然倒地。
李长生这套连招，行云流水，狠辣至极。
甚至他从头到尾都没有踏出房门半步。
仅仅三息时间。
两名刽子手，就变成了两具焦黑的尸体。
苟修不轻易出手。
但一旦出手必死人。
李长生神识一卷，将两人的储物袋卷入屋内。
随后丢几张化尸符，融化尸体，清理战场，毁尸灭迹。
李长生是很稳健的人。

虽然他房子有屏蔽阵法，有静音符，但是刚刚动静太大了，而且处于屏蔽阵法边沿，仅仅依靠外面的隔音层，难免会露出一些动静。
但是也要做到最好。
做事不留痕。
事了拂衣去。
深藏功与名。
“夫君，外面……”
江翠萍虚弱地问道。
李长生重新走进房间，温和地开口：“没事了。”
江翠萍：“可惜，我只是凡人，帮不上你。”
李长生：“你现在啥也别想，安心将老二生下来，就是对我最大的帮助。”
“好的。”
江翠萍重重地点点头。
李长生：“来，跟着我，呼气，吸气……”
呼！……
吸！……
“啊。。”
江翠萍突然发出一声高亢的尖叫，双手抓着床单，指关节发白。
“头出来了。”
“肩膀也出来了。”
“最后一下。”

“用力。”
“呼气。”
“吸气。”
李长生双手托住那小小的身躯，鼓励江翠萍。
突然……
“哇。。。”
一阵比宁宁出生时，更洪亮啼哭声，传遍了整栋房子。
是个带把的。
李长生大喜过望。
闺女有了。
儿子有了。
老子这辈子，儿女双全了。
李长生高兴得像个孩子一样，原地蹦起来。
脸上胡子一抖一抖的。
显得极为滑稽。
与此同时。
在长子降生的同时，系统冰冷的电子合成音也随之响了起来。
【恭喜宿主，凡人妻诞下麟儿。】
【家族血脉+1。】
【由于是宿主的长子，且母体为凡人，但在极度危险环境下诞生，触发逆天改命级暴击。】

【奖励一：宿主寿元+50年。】
【奖励二：修为突破至筑基初期（无瑕道基）。】
【奖励三：《青帝长生诀》（筑基卷）。】
【奖励四：神通：【苟道长青】（被动：可完美隐匿修为，非高出两个大境界者不可查探；主动：燃烧寿元，瞬间爆发十倍战力，持续三息）。】
【奖励五：长子获得特殊体质：先天剑体（未觉醒）。】
【奖励六：长子获得极品单灵根（金灵根）。】
李长生看到系统的奖励，更加高兴。
喜上加喜。
双喜临门。
【寿命】
【修为】
【功法】
【神通】
四样东西都是好东西。
也许是因为老二的降生，命运多舛，系统给的奖励并不比第一次差。
真的太爽了。
如果给我一点时间。
我将系统奖励的东西都消化了。
就能晋升筑基期了。
好消息：我很快筑基了，修为跟谢剑一个境界了。

坏消息：谢剑背后有人，不排除杀了谢剑后，其幕后之人会出现的可能。
总的来说是好事。
筑基期在安置区，至少有破局的资本了。
这时江翠萍虚弱的声音将李长生拉回现实。
“夫君，是儿子？还是女儿？”
李长生低头，看着浑身红彤彤、哭声震天响的小子，露出笑容。
“是个儿子。”
“咱们有后了。”
“而且……”
李长生回想起，刚刚的系统提示。
【先天剑体】
【极品金灵根】
而且这天赋比宁宁还要恐怖啊。
如果说宁宁是奶妈和后勤总管。
这小子就是天生的杀神。
是为了战斗而生的剑仙胚子。
水木生生不息。
金锐无坚不摧。
一柔一刚。
一个真凤。

一个真龙。
老李家的未来稳了。
“而且什么？”
江翠萍急切地追问。
“而且咱们的儿子修炼天赋很优秀。”
李长生只是笼统简单地说一下。
江翠萍无法修炼，只是一介凡人，了解这些东西，只不过是徒增忧愁。
“好啊！”
“修炼天赋高。”
“以后长大后就能保护咱们了。”
江翠萍看着尚在襁褓中的儿子，眼泪止不住流下来。
终于给夫君生了男孩了。
我没有给夫君丢人。
或许在江翠萍这种传统的村妇中。
儿子永远是执念。
李长生却没有这种老思想，生儿子未必就是好事情啊！
儿子都是惹祸精。
后面还要给他娶媳妇。
哪样不是麻烦？
如果抛去这些麻烦不谈，生个儿子，继承香火还是挺好的。

家族兴旺系统嘛。
不继承香火怎么行呢？
所以男孩子还是要的。
但是男孩子就要多吃苦。
这时江翠萍淡淡的声音又传过来了。
“那咱们的儿子叫什么名字呢？”
李长生想了想，沉吟片刻。
目光看向窗外那笼罩着血色的夜空，眼中闪过一丝凌厉的剑意。
“姐姐叫以宁。”
“那是求安宁。”
“但这小子生于乱世，生于杀戮之夜。”
“而且身怀剑体，未来注定要荡平世间不平事。”
“就叫李荡平吧。”
“不求他一生安宁，反而希望他能建功立业，荡平世间不平事，唯剑作伴。”
“李荡平。荡平世间不平事，建功立业，唯剑作伴。好名字啊。”江翠萍喃喃自语。
这小子听到自己的名字叫李荡平，裂开嘴巴，笑得很欢。
仿佛很喜欢这个名字。
李长生拿起剪刀，帮儿子剪去脐带。
然后又往其体内送进去一缕灵力。
因为安置区被封锁了。

无法购买灵鹿奶。
只能食五谷，辅奶，以灵气辅助了。
只是这样一来，就苦了李长生。
要将自己辛苦修炼的灵气，给一部分自己的儿子。
李长生在房间内，呆了一个多小时，一切处理妥当之后。
迅速来到地下室。
刚刚出手杀死那两个魔修。
并没有绝对保险。
很有可能消息已经暴露出去了。
或许危机很快就会降临。
他必须要趁着间隙，迅速变强。
李长生盘膝在地下室中央，心念一动：
“系统，具现奖励。”
【收到指令。】
【正在具现奖励中……】
【寿命增加】
【修为增加】
【功法记忆融合】
【神通融合】
系统一直都是全部奖励一起具现。

非常省事。
一点都不麻烦。
李长生随之感到体内凭空出现一股暖流。
从四肢百骸流动。
最后重归于丹田。
原本他资质差，即便穷尽一辈子，都无望筑基的。
但是此刻。
具现了系统奖励。
筑基瓶颈就像不存在一样。
修为节节攀升。
李长生丹田内的气态灵力，开始疯狂压缩、旋转、液化，由气态转化为真元。
越来越多灵力转化为真元。
只要将体内的所有灵气都转化为真元。
即为筑基。
李长生的身体也在发生变化。
骨骼重组。
经脉拓宽。
五脏六腑都在散发着莹莹宝光。
神识更是扩张了数倍。
两百丈……

五百丈……
一千丈。
整整覆盖了三里范围。
这范围非常恐怖，比寻常的筑基期要强，甚至已经可以媲美筑基后期的修士了。
李长生感觉到，自己的寿命上限，也被打破了。
那种行将就木的腐朽气息再一扫而空。
取而代之的。
是磅礴的生机。
若不是刻意压制。
恐怕此刻他已经返老还童。
变回了那个二十岁的英俊青年。
寿命的增加，再加上修为的突破，往往会有化腐朽为神奇的力量。
李长生握了握拳头，战斗力比炼气期强了十倍不止。
“这就是筑基期吗？”
“的确感觉不一样了。”
不再是那个人人可欺的炼气老头。
而是一名真正的筑基大修。
在青云宗，筑基期已是外门长老级别，拥有开辟洞府，收徒授业的资格。
如果青云门没有腐朽的话。
在凡人聚集的安置区。

便是无敌的存在。
但是现在的话，能否自保，都未可知。
李长生忍着激动，心念一动。
神通【苟道长青】发动。
原本沸腾的气息瞬间平复下去。
筑基威压也消失得无影无踪。
仿佛他依然是炼气三层的老头，甚至气息还比之前更萎靡一些。
哪怕无敌。
也要稳健。
这才是长生之道。
content_en:
In an instant.
The sudden change.
The originally weak courtyard door suddenly became as dark as ink.
The terrifying suction force suddenly erupted.
"What?"
Scarface exclaimed and wanted to draw his knife and retreat, but found himself stuck in the mud.
Couldn't move at all.
Immediately afterwards.
The ground exploded.
Dozens of second-level explosive talismans that had been buried long ago were instantly detonated like powder keg.
The fierce fire engulfed the courtyard entrance.
There wasn't much noise.
Because Li Changsheng also put a layer of soundproof barrier on the outermost layer.
All the power of the explosion was compressed within a radius of three feet, and the power was doubled.
"Ah."
"My legs."
"What kind of talisman is this? Why is it so powerful?"
The two demon cultivators were instantly stunned.
The protective spirit shield was as fragile as a piece of paper in front of the improved third-level top-grade explosive flame talisman.
It shattered almost instantly.
The two demon cultivators were immediately stunned.
My head is dizzy.
Haven't recovered yet.
Li Changsheng used his spiritual consciousness to control the Xuanshuang Sword and fired out several sword energy.
The Xuan Shuang Sword is a Xuan level spiritual weapon.
It is already very powerful.
And he was unprepared.
The two demon cultivators had no time to escape.
The sword energy accurately penetrated the eyebrows, throats, and hearts of the two people.
Life is cut off.
Falling to the ground with a crash.
Li Changsheng's combo moves were smooth and ruthless.
He didn't even step out of the room from beginning to end.
Only three breaths of time.
The two executioners turned into two charred corpses.
Gou Xiu doesn't take action easily.
But once you take action, someone will die.
Li Changsheng's consciousness rolled up and rolled the two people's storage bags into the house.
Then throw a few corpse transformation talismans to melt the corpse, clean up the battlefield, and destroy the corpse.
Li Changsheng is a very stable person.
Although his house has a shielding formation and a mute note, there was too much movement just now, and it was on the edge of the shielding formation. Just relying on the sound insulation layer outside, some movement would inevitably be revealed.
But also do your best.
Do things without leaving a trace.
When it's over, brush off your clothes and go.
Hidden merit and fame.
"Husband, outside..."
Jiang Cuiping asked weakly.
Li Changsheng walked into the room again and said gently: "It's okay."
Jiang Cuiping: "Unfortunately, I am only a mortal and can't help you."
Li Changsheng: "Don't think about anything now. Giving birth to your second child with peace of mind is the greatest help to me."
"Okay."
Jiang Cuiping nodded heavily.
Li Changsheng: "Come, follow me, exhale, inhale..."
Phew! ……
suck! …
"Ah..."
Jiang Cuiping suddenly let out a high-pitched scream, grabbing the sheets with both hands, her knuckles turning white.
"The head is out."
"The shoulders are out too."
"One last moment."
"Harder."
"Exhale."
"Breathe in."
Li Changsheng held the small body with both hands and encouraged Jiang Cuiping.
suddenly...
"Wow..."
A louder cry than when Ningning was born spread throughout the house.
It's a handler.
Li Changsheng was overjoyed.
The daughter is born.
I have a son.
In this life, I have both children and a daughter.
Li Changsheng was as happy as a child, jumping up on the spot.
The beard on his face was trembling.
Seems extremely funny.
at the same time.
At the same time as the eldest son was born, the system's cold electronic synthesized sound also sounded.
[Congratulations to the host, the mortal wife gave birth to Lin'er. 】
[Family bloodline +1. 】
[Because he is the eldest son of the host, and his mother is a mortal, but he was born in an extremely dangerous environment, triggering a life-changing critical strike. 】
[Reward 1: Host life span +50 years. 】
[Reward 2: Break through to the early stage of foundation building (Flawless Dao Foundation). 】
[Reward three: "Qing Emperor's Secret of Immortality" (Foundation Building Volume). 】
[Reward 4: Divine Power: [Goudao Evergreen] (Passive: can perfectly hide the cultivation level, and cannot be detected by those who have to be two realms higher; Active: burn life energy, instantly bursting out ten times the combat power,Lasts three breaths). 】
[Reward 5: The eldest son obtains a special physique: Innate Sword Body (not awakened). 】
[Reward 6: The eldest son obtains the best single spiritual root (golden spiritual root). 】
Li Changsheng was even more happy when he saw the rewards from the system.
Joy upon joy.
Double happiness.
【Lifespan】
【Cultivation】
【Gong method】
【Supernatural power】
All four are good things.
Perhaps because of the unfortunate birth of the second child, the reward given by the system was no worse than the first time.
It's so cool.
If you give me some time.
I digested everything the system rewarded.
You can advance to the foundation building stage.
Good news: I quickly established my foundation, and my cultivation level is at the same level as Xie Jian's.
Bad news: There is someone behind Xie Jian. We do not rule out the possibility that the person behind Xie Jian will appear after killing Xie Jian.
Overall a good thing.
In the foundation building period, we are in the resettlement area, so we at least have the capital to break the situation.
At this time, Jiang Cuiping's weak voice brought Li Changsheng back to reality.
"Husband, are you a son? Or a daughter?"
Li Changsheng lowered his head, looked at the boy who was all red and crying loudly, and smiled.
"It's a son."
"We are having a baby."
"And..."
Li Changsheng recalled the system prompt just now.
[Innate Sword Body]
[The best golden spirit root]
And this talent is even more terrifying than Ning Ning's.
If Ningning is the nanny and logistics manager.
This kid is a born killer.
It is a sword fairy embryo born for fighting.
Water and wood are endless.
Jin Rui is indestructible.
One soft and one strong.
A real phoenix.
A real dragon.
The future of Lao Li's family is stable.
"And what?"
Jiang Cuiping asked eagerly.
"And our son is very talented in cultivation."
Li Changsheng just spoke in general terms.
Jiang Cuiping cannot cultivate, she is just a mortal, and understanding these things will only increase her sorrow.
"Okay!"
"High talent in cultivation."
"You will be able to protect us when you grow up."
Jiang Cuiping looked at her infant son and couldn't stop crying.
Finally, my husband gave birth to a boy.
I did not embarrass my husband.
Perhaps among traditional village women like Jiang Cuiping.
My son is always my obsession.
Li Changsheng does not have this old idea. Giving birth to a son may not be a good thing!
Sons are troublemakers.
She will also marry him a wife later.
What's not troublesome?
If you put aside these troubles, it would be nice to have a son and inherit the family legacy.
It's a family prosperity system.
What if you don’t inherit the incense?
So boys still want it.
But boys have to endure more hardship.
At this time Jiang Cuiping's faint voice came again.
"Then what is our son's name?"
Li Changsheng thought about it and pondered for a moment.
Looking out the window at the blood-colored night sky, a sharp sword intent flashed in his eyes.
"My sister's name is Yi Ning."
"That's for peace."
"But this kid was born in troubled times, on a night of killing."
"And with his sword body, he is destined to rectify injustices in the world in the future."
"Let's call him Li Dangping."
"I don't want him to have a peaceful life, but I hope he can make great achievements and put an end to injustices in the world, with only the sword as his companion."
"Li Dangping. To rectify the injustices in the world and make achievements, only the sword can accompany him. What a good name." Jiang Cuiping murmured to herself.
When the boy heard that his name was Li Dangping, his mouth split open and he smiled happily.
I seem to like this name very much.
Li Changsheng picked up the scissors and helped his son cut off the umbilical cord.
Then he sent a ray of spiritual power into his body.
Because the resettlement area is blocked.
Linglu milk cannot be purchased.
I can only eat grains, supplement milk, and use spiritual energy to assist.
Just doing this will cause Li Changsheng a lot of pain.
I want to give some of the spiritual energy I have cultivated so hard to my son.
Li Changsheng stayed in the room for more than an hour, after everything was settled.
Quickly come to the basement.
justTake action to kill the two demon cultivators.
There is no absolute insurance.
It's possible that the news has already been exposed.
Maybe a crisis will come soon.
He must take advantage of the gap to quickly become stronger.
Li Changsheng was sitting cross-legged in the middle of the basement, thinking:
"The system presents rewards."
[Instruction received. 】
[Rewards are being realized...]
【Increased lifespan】
[Increase in cultivation]
[Function memory fusion]
【Supernatural Fusion】
The system has always realized all rewards together.
Very hassle-free.
No hassle at all.
Li Changsheng then felt a warm current appear in his body out of thin air.
Flows from the limbs and bones.
Finally returned to Dantian.
Originally, he had poor qualifications, and even if he spent his whole life, there was no hope of building a foundation.
But at this moment.
System rewards are realized.
It's like the foundation bottleneck doesn't exist.
Cultivation level is rising steadily.
The gaseous spiritual power in Li Changsheng's dantian began to compress, rotate, and liquefy crazily, transforming from gaseous state into real energy.
More and more spiritual energy is converted into true energy.
As long as all the spiritual energy in the body is transformed into true energy.
That is to build the foundation.
Li Changsheng's body is also changing.
Bone reorganization.
The meridians are widened.
All the internal organs are exuding a gleaming precious light.
His spiritual consciousness expanded several times.
Two hundred feet...
Five hundred feet...
One thousand feet.
It covers an entire area of ​​three miles.
This range is very terrifying, stronger than the ordinary foundation building stage, and even comparable to monks in the late foundation building stage.
Li Changsheng felt that the upper limit of his life span had also been exceeded.
The rotten smell of dying was once again swept away.
Instead.
It is a majestic life.
If it is not deliberately suppressed.
I'm afraid he's rejuvenated now.
He turned back into that handsome twenty-year-old man.
Increased lifespan, coupled with breakthroughs in cultivation, often have the power to turn decay into miraculous things.
Li Changsheng clenched his fist, his fighting power was more than ten times stronger than during the Qi Refining stage.
"Is this the foundation building period?"
"It does feel different."
He is no longer the old man who can be bullied by others.
But a real foundation-building overhaul.
In the Qingyun Sect, at the foundation stage, they are already at the level of outer sect elders and have the qualifications to open caves and recruit disciples.
If Qingyun Gate is not decayed.
In the settlement area where mortals gather.
It is an invincible existence.
But now, it is unclear whether we can protect ourselves.
Li Changsheng held back his excitement and thought.
The magical power [Gou Dao Changqing] is activated.
The boiling breath calmed down instantly.
The pressure of foundation building also disappeared without a trace.
It was as if he was still an old man at the third level of Qi Refining, and his aura was even weaker than before.
Even invincible.
Also be steady.
This is the way to live forever.
